user.title: Connect Deye inverter
user.description: Select your inverter model and enter the Modbus connection details. Deye WiFi/LAN loggers usually expose Modbus TCP on port 8899; RS485-to-TCP gateways commonly use 502.

init.title: Options
init.description: Writes are off by default. When enabled, battery, grid-charge, work-mode and time-of-use settings become editable. Every change is range-checked, rate-limited (one write per register every 30 s) and read back from the inverter.
